ask: Should the designer agent run /design itself, or should I run /design and hand the canvas to the builder?
note: Needs Claude Code v2.1.234 or later with artifacts available. The standalone claude.ai/design site closes Dec 14, 2026; the Design artifact type stays.
title: Use /design as the designer's canvas
why: Claude Code's /design drafts a mockup as artboards on a Claude Design canvas, published as an artifact. /design-sync pulls a repo's design system in first, and a finished design can be handed back to Claude Code to build. That is the designer step, already built.
